body:
```
source ─▶ parseJSON (jsonc-parser) ─▶ { value, errors, strict }

value ─▶ renderJsonTree(
           guards for undefined / null / primitive roots,
           JSONErrorBoundary
           ─▶ <JsonView value theme … />  (@uiw/react-json-view)
         )
```

- `jsonc-parser`: tolerant of `//` + `/* */` comments and trailing commas.
- Strict-mode detection: if the source also parses with native
  `JSON.parse`, `strict: true` → shows a "valid" pill; else "jsonc"
  pill. Parse errors render in an expandable details strip with line /
  column info.
- Theme: picks one of nine bundled themes
  (`githubDark` / `githubLight` / `nord` / `vscode` / `basic` / `dark`
  / `light` / `monokai` / `gruvbox`) via `options.theme` or follows host
  `ThemeProvider.mode` when `theme: "auto"`.
- Large-file threshold (1 MB): renders collapsed at depth 1 with a hint
  to switch to Raw.
